contract: Phase 4 design contract: retain Aksara's existing warm-neutral/green interface. The popup prioritizes explicit source/target choices, Enable image controls, and compact model readiness. Setup explains the approximately 912 MB local model download, requires an explicit Download action, shows progress and stored bytes, and offers cancellation/resume/verification/removal. Page results show selectable translated text with source text available; aligned overlays belong to Phase 5. Preserve labeled controls, visible focus, bounded text, narrow-screen wrapping and no automatic model download. Local references: popup.html, options.html, src/style.css and Phase 3 captures.

accessibility.evidence: Final 0.4.0 browser audit reports zero axe violations for page results and Setup at all three target viewports, the popup, and the actual partial-download state. Keyboard Enter starts a page translation. Labels, visible focus, selectable read-only text and reachable actions were inspected in rendered captures. The options footer contrast was repaired from 4.17:1 to 5.76:1 and the affected browser audit passed. This is scoped evidence; native popup/dialog and screen-reader checks remain manual.

responsive.evidence: Final page and Setup captures at 375x812, 768x900 and 1440x900 were visually reviewed. Browser assertions verify card viewport containment and no horizontal overflow. Narrow Setup headings wrap beside Refresh, action buttons stack, disclosure text remains readable and diagnostics stay bounded. The 330-pixel popup content fits in approximately 540 vertical pixels in the rendered fixture; native Chrome popup behavior is not claimed as tested.

loading.evidence: translation-loading.png captures actual model preparation for a page image. translation-download-running.png captures a real pinned model download with percentage and Cancel. Cancellation closes page inference; cancellation of preparation keeps completed chunks.

empty.evidence: translation-setup-empty.png is a first-use popup capture (the filename is historical), showing that the model needs preparation. translation-download-removed.png shows the actual Setup page with zero cached bytes and the explicit Download action after successful removal.

error.evidence: translation-model-required.png shows the actual MODEL_NOT_READY recovery path while preserving recognized text. Browser cases also force a service-worker interruption, reclaim its orphaned translation worker and successfully retry. Storage/GPU/OOM failures have policy/unit coverage rather than claims of induced browser hardware failures.

partial.evidence: The real download probe cancels with 34,113,594 bytes retained, resumes missing ranges to 50,890,810 bytes, and reuses a completed 16 MiB range. translation-download-partial.png shows retained bytes and Resume; translation-download-resumed.png shows the increased local cache. Page OCR also remains available when translation is not ready.

success.evidence: Final translation-375/768/1440 captures show two actual NLLB results: Buka pintunya. and Selamat pagi., with recognized source text below. Setup and popup captures show the ready local model. English-to-Indonesian, Indonesian-to-English, English-to-French, warm reuse and cold offline translation passed.

permission.evidence: Opening setup and a page Translate click without prepared weights produce zero model requests; a missing consent flag is rejected. The separate download probe clicks the explicit approximately 912 MB download control before real Hugging Face GETs begin. No image or text request body is sent.

renderedEvidence.observation: Narrow translated/source text card stays inside the viewport, with clear labels and visible focus. It covers part of the original image as expected for the Phase 4 preview.
Tablet card preserves the two translated lines, original OCR and reachable Dismiss without overlap or horizontal overflow.
Desktop card places the emphasized translation above its source, with bounded fields and clear status/focus.
Setup wraps the model heading beside Refresh, stacks controls, and retains readable download/privacy/license information and bounded diagnostics.
Setup's disclosure, ready state and action groups use the available tablet width without clipped text or controls.
The centered maximum-width layout maintains readable lines and separates model preparation from diagnostics.
Popup language labels, source/target selectors, activation, model readiness and Setup action fit the 330-pixel content column.
Real download state names the operation, shows percentage/local bytes and provides Cancel. Conflicting model actions are disabled.
Cancelled preparation retains visible local bytes and offers Resume or Remove, with no misleading completed state.
Successful removal confirms zero local model bytes and restores the explicit Download action.
